notes: v399 — FIX for the 📋 outcome-window switch shipped in v398: if the 10d/30d buttons were tapped before the server update was applied, the server's 5-day answer got remembered under the wrong slot and later taps looked like a dead button (no spinner, no change). Now the card only trusts an answer that matches the window it asked for, never caches a mismatched one, and if your server is still on the old version it says so in plain words on the card — with the exact fix — instead of going silent. Every tap re-asks until the right answer arrives. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
